descripcion: Conjunto de VALIDACION: preguntas escritas ANTES de medir y que no se usan para ajustar recetas, ejemplos ni prompts. Se mide con bi_evaluar_oro.py --dataset ... Cualquier receta nueva debe probarse en otro conjunto.

preguntas.pregunta: cual es el producto con mas existencias
preguntas.oro: SELECT descripcion FROM product WHERE deletion_date IS NULL ORDER BY cantidad DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

preguntas.pregunta: cuantos productos tienen existencia en cero
preguntas.oro: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND cantidad = 0

preguntas.pregunta: cuantas marcas de herramientas hay registradas
preguntas.oro: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brand WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND product_status ILIKE 'EXTRAVIADO'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_family WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND incident_status = 'cerrada'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND incident_status = 'cancelado'

preguntas.pregunta: cuantos vales se crearon en los ultimos 30 dias
preguntas.oro: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND incident_date >= now() - interval '30 days'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident_type WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nm_incident_product WHERE deletion_date IS NULL

preguntas.pregunta: cuantas herramientas estan pendientes de devolver
preguntas.oro: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nm_incident_product WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND close_date IS NULL
SELECT incident_status, COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY incident_status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proyect WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND proyect_status = 'in_progress'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proyect WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND proyect_status = 'blocked'
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM proyect p JOIN customer_supplier c ON c.id_customer_supplier = p.id_customer_supplier WHERE p.deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY c.name

preguntas.pregunta: cual es el proyecto con mayor costo total

SELECT id_proyect, COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY id_proyect
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order WHERE deletion_date IS NULL

preguntas.pregunta: cuantas ordenes de compra hay por estatus

preguntas.pregunta: cual es el monto total de las ordenes de compra

SELECT SUM(total) FROM invoice WHERE deletion_date IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_supplier WHERE deletion_date IS NULL

preguntas.pregunta: cual es la factura de mayor importe

preguntas.pregunta: cuanto se ha facturado por mes
preguntas.oro: SELECT date_trunc('month', date_emision) AS mes, SUM(total) FROM invoice WHERE deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "user" WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND is_employee = true
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM department WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
